newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw to end higher.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates fluctuated to close higher on Wednesday amid a shortage of funds, and dealers said rates were likely to open higher on Thursday.

Overnight funds were initially traded between 17 and 15 percent, one dealer said. News the State (central) Bank of Pakistan had rejected all bids in an open market operation brought the rates down, and major deals were then done in the range of 10 to 12 percent, the dealer said.
But in a surprise move, a major state-run bank came into the market as a borrower, pushing rates up to 20 percent at the close, he said. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
